about_the_game:
🎣 About This Game

Welcome to Voodoo Fishin’, a co-op fishing adventure with tight lines and supernatural stakes.

Explore haunted bayous, cursed coastlines, and deep-water mysteries as a fully customizable puppet angler. Whether you're braving the waters solo or teaming up in online multiplayer, every cast brings a chance at a legendary catch—or something far more dangerous.

🪝 Features:

  • 🎭 Custom Puppet Characters
    Craft your perfect voodoo fisher-puppet with a wild assortment of outfits

  • 🧠 Solo or Co-Op Multiplayer
    Go it alone, or join friends in online sessions with up to 4 players. Coordinate your catches—or compete for the biggest prize.

  • 🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat
    Whisper ghost stories by the campfire or shout across the swamp when something bites. Voice carries... and so do the things that listen.

  • 🧰 Build Your Tackle Loadout
    Buy, customize, and upgrade your rods, reels, lures, and bait to suit your fishing style. Match your gear to each region—or risk going in unprepared.

  • 🌎 Explore a Living, Breathing (and Dying) World
    Each fishing hole hides its own secrets. Discover new zones, uncover hidden catches, and stay alert—not all creatures are content to stay below the surface..

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (8-12GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A multiplayer co-op fishing adventure where you explore eerie waters, customize your puppet angler, upgrade tackle, and stay alert—there’s more than fish lurking out there.
